description: This source file defines an Android Activity that demonstrates how to display the input method subtype enabler UI, either for all input methods or for specific ones, bypassing a potentially broken API method.

classes.name: ShowInputMethodAndSubtypeEnabler
classes.description: An Android Activity that creates a UI with buttons to show the input method subtype enabler for all or specific input methods.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up buttons for showing input method settings, and dynamically adds buttons for input methods with multiple subtypes.

methods.name: showInputMethodAndSubtypeEnabler
methods.description: Starts the input method subtype enabler settings activity for a specified input method ID.

methods.name: getEnabledInputMethodsThatHaveMultipleSubtypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of enabled input methods that have more than one subtype.
